description: Set whether the robot vacuums, mops or does both, optionally with a suction level and water flow. Omitted levels keep the current non-off value. Values outside the configured supported lists are rejected with 422 before dispatch.

mode.description: What a cleaning robot does: vacuum only, mop only, or vacuum and mop together

suctionLevel.description: Vacuum suction level, ordered from off to strongest

waterFlow.description: Mop water flow level, ordered from off to highest
